name: youtube-editor
description: Frame-accurate video editing agent for YouTube and short-form reels, with proof. The cs-youtube-video-editor agent makes the editorial calls and stdlib tools on ffmpeg do the work to the exact frame and audio sample: media_analyzer.py measures and proposes word-safe cuts; viral_planner.py turns a transcript into a retention edit for Shorts, Reels and TikTok (hook title card, jump cuts, zoom rhythm, punch-ins on key words, karaoke captions, synthesized sound effects, flash/shake/glitch/black-and-white shocks, progress bar, CTA framing, loop ending) with written editor's notes; retention_audit.py scores a plan 0-100 with fixes; edit_planner.py compiles any EDL into a frame- and sample-exact plan; effects_library.py adds 50+ transitions and effects; render_engine.py renders by frame and sample index with sound effects placed to the sample and loudness re-measured to -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP; edit_verifier.py refuses to call an edit done until frame count, every cut, audio alignment, sound-effect placement, transitions, effect edge frames, captions, loudness and upload spec pass, with negative controls; timeline_remapper.py carries chapters and captions through the edit. No uploads, no API keys, never touches the source file.
